errors.text_span: като най-големият (син) започва от 12 часа и се движи по посока на часовниковата стрелка
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the largest sector (blue) starts at the 12 o'clock position and that the sectors are arranged clockwise. In the figure, the blue sector is at the bottom, and the sectors are arranged counter-clockwise in descending order of size starting from the blue one.
